subject: qbank.spec 'finishing a block, the Lab values panel…' intermittently fails axe (WebKit portrait/phone; once Chromium)
body: Seen in 3 of ~6 local smoke runs on claude/naadi-shared + S12b (S12b does not touch the Lab values sheet): axe target-size on button[aria-label=Close] in the sheet (webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-phone-390), and once color-contrast on section[aria-labelledby=labs-chemistry] .text-text-3 cells (chromium-laptop-1440). Looks like axe running before the sheet finished opening, or a real 24px/contrast issue on those cells. FYI only.
